name: Skeleton Warrior
description: A dirt-covered skeleton armed with a rusted blade.

abilities.name: Only Bones
abilities.description: The Warrior is resistant to physical damage.

abilities.name: Won’t Stay Dead
abilities.description: When the Warrior is defeated, you can spotlight them and roll a d6. On a result of 6, if there are other adversaries on the battlefield, the Warrior re-forms with no marked HP.
